query ViewerCapabilities($ownerId: String, $fresh: Boolean) {
  viewerCapabilities(ownerId: $ownerId, fresh: $fresh) {
    role
    canView
    canViewLogs
    canOperate
    canCreate
    canViewSensitive
    canManageKeys
    canManage
    canManageBilling
    fresh
    grants {
      action
      outcome
      reason
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

1723.query:
query Services($ownerId: String) {
  services(ownerId: $ownerId) {
    id
    name
    immutableName
    slug
    displayName
    type
    suspended
    dashboardUrl
    url
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    runtime
    region
    phase
    replicas
    revision
    plan
    idleTTLSeconds
    __typename
  }
}

query EnvGroupScopeIndex($ownerId: String!) {
  projects(ownerId: $ownerId) {
    ...ProjectFields
    __typename
  }
  workspaceEnvironments(ownerId: $ownerId) {
    ...EnvironmentFields
    __typename
  }
}

fragment ProjectFields on Project {
  id
  name
  ownerId
  createdAt
  serviceIds
  databaseIds
  keyValueIds
  __typename
}

fragment EnvironmentFields on Environment {
  id
  projectId
  name
  ownerId
  createdAt
  serviceIds
  databaseIds
  keyValueIds
  envGroupIds
  protectedStatus
  networkIsolationEnabled
  ipAllowList
  ipAllowListEntries {
    cidrBlock
    description
    __typename
  }
  ipAllowListProxiedDomains
  __typename
}

scopeNotes: The initial populated create timed out with WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and a terminal response. A complete owner read omitted its name before a single empty same-name create recovered. Native patch then populated it, and the native clone preserved all four entries. This records existing m206 admission behavior; m206 is not closed.

The326 remaining gate concerns present empty-file read shape, nonempty/missing/GraphQL controls and independent native clone editing. Those all pass. Initial-content create admission, generic clone timing and all m206 scope/move/reservation gates are not accepted by this pass.

REST group metadata remains names-only live. Names-only PUT acknowledgements and inferred MCP output schema remain maintained implementation regressions; no new live PUT, schema-list, refused or unavailable-runtime probes were made.
The original finding and implementation notes retain SDK path research and old-shape failures. This acceptance adds actual production receipts without changing product code or rerunning suites.

One ViewerCapabilities read failed net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED, one DeployActions read aborted around navigation, and one post-delete group/services/scope read lacked a completion at snapshot. Later native pages and independent reads succeeded; no reproducible impact was established, so no new finding is claimed. Snapshot205 is native browser traffic only; explicit page.request probes have their own receipts.

Harness errors excluded: nonexistent env-groups/new route redirected home; Add variable first opens a menu; value labels become key-specific; service delete button is Delete Service; malformed serviceLinks sub-selection and guessed applyingSavedChanges field were corrected. No writer was replayed from a missing observer receipt.
No Vault purge inspection, foreign-resource mutation, paid action, Chinese UI, other browser or authenticated Render comparison.
Public serving-state GETs used the browser HTTP client; external curl checked post-delete404 only.
